evals.name: explicit-skill-command-positive
evals.prompt: /skill quark-skill-creator I want to add a new skill for FP4 quantization workflow.
expectations: Claude loads .claude/skills-impl/meta/shared/quark-skill-creator/SKILL.md as the active skill.
Phase 1 (Capture Intent) is the first thing the assistant does — it asks for skill name, intent, layer, primary artifact, and trigger phrases before drafting.
The assistant does not jump straight to scripts/scaffold_skill.py without explicit confirmation.

evals.name: natural-language-quark-skill-positive
evals.prompt: We need a new Quark agent skill that wraps quark.torch.export. Where do I start?
expectations: Claude routes to quark-skill-creator because the prompt is explicitly about authoring a Quark skill.
Claude does not route to quark-torch-skill-sync (governance audit, not authoring) or quark-torch-doc-drift-check (upstream drift check).

evals.name: general-skill-creation-negative
evals.prompt: I want to create a Claude skill for parsing nginx logs and emailing me the summary.
expectations: Claude does NOT invoke quark-skill-creator — the request is for a generic Claude skill, not a Quark agent skill, and quark-skill-creator's domain is the Quark skill ecosystem only.
Claude either falls through to a general-purpose skill creator or asks for clarification, but does not load .claude/skills-impl/meta/shared/quark-skill-creator/SKILL.md.

evals.name: governance-audit-boundary-negative
evals.prompt: Audit all existing skills in .claude/skills-impl/ and report which ones are missing required sections.
expectations: Claude routes to quark-torch-skill-sync (governance audit of existing skills), NOT to quark-skill-creator (authoring of a new skill).
If quark-skill-creator is loaded, it stops at Phase 1 once the assistant realizes the user is asking for an audit of existing skills, not authoring a new one.

evals.name: ptq-end-user-boundary-negative
evals.prompt: Quantize Llama-3-8B to FP8 with default settings.
expectations: Claude routes to quark-torch-ptq (end-user PTQ workflow), NOT to quark-skill-creator.
quark-skill-creator's description explicitly says 'maintainer-facing meta skill, not an end-user PTQ tool', which the routing surface should respect.

evals.name: validate-skill-produces-valid-report
evals.prompt: Run scripts/validate_skill.py against .claude/skills-impl/meta/shared/quark-skill-creator and capture the report.
expectations: validate_skill.py exits with code 0 (PASS — no findings) on the meta skill itself.
Output stdout matches the format documented in scripts/validate_skill.py docstring: 'validate_skill: <path>' header followed by either 'PASS — no findings' or BLOCK / WARN lines.
The same script run against quark-torch-skill-sync, quark-torch-doc-drift-check, quark-torch-eval-runner also exits 0 (no regression on existing meta skills).
